truthAudit.Summary: Run 2 matched 14 true items fully, 2 partially, and missed 4. It also included one unlisted extra finding and several severity or CWE overclaims/underclaims that require correction.

Items.Notes: Run 2 explicitly found the variable printf format in log_debug_message and cited runtime_log_format and log_format configuration. It underclaimed severity as Medium instead of Critical.
Run 2's fact finding cited the factorial loop and its impact said signed overflow; this covers the integer overflow, although it classified it as CWE-400/DoS and used Medium severity.
Run 2 identified UAF from staged deferred history flush tasks reading scratch after pool cleanup, but underclaimed severity as High.
Run 2 found command injection in ConfigLoader::validate_config from validator_cmd + config_file, but underclaimed severity as High.

Run 2 found the inverted strcpy stack overflow but did not identify the safe_string_copy off-by-one (dest[src_len] when src_len == dest_size) and used CWE-787/Critical rather than CWE-120/CWE-121/High.
Run 2 identified the counter data race, but underclaimed severity as Low instead of Medium.
Run 2 identified the emergency override after more than five failed attempts, but labeled it CWE-287 authentication bypass and Critical rather than CWE-511 logic bomb High.
Run 2 identified path traversal in load_config with matching CWE and severity.
Run 2 identified unbounded strcpy into the 256-byte expression buffer, but underclaimed severity as High and used CWE-787 instead of CWE-122.
Run 2 identified the hardcoded administrator secret with matching CWE and severity.
Run 2 identified weak PRNG and 1000-9999 token range, but underclaimed severity as Low instead of High and minimized impact.
Run 2 did not identify the thread-unsafe static std::tm cached_time / localtime cache in log_debug_message.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Environment variables such as TMPDIR or TEMP are concatenated into a shell command.
Items.Notes: Run 2 found the environment-controlled temporary audit path and system() call, but framed it as CWE-78 command injection with High severity rather than the audited CWE-377 insecure temporary file handling Medium.
Run 2 did not identify persistent authentication state / lack of logout for authenticated_, login_attempts_, and session_token_ as CWE-613.
Run 2 did not identify unhandled exception from std::stod(tokens[3]) in handle_variable_command.
Run 2 identified the unsigned underflow in MemoryPool split logic, but underclaimed severity as High instead of Critical.
Run 2 identified unbounded recursion from nested parentheses, but underclaimed severity as Medium instead of High.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: result_cache_ without lock_guard or unique_lock on cache_mutex_
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified the unsynchronized result cache race, but overclaimed severity as High instead of Medium.
Run 2 did not identify the TOCTOU window from filesystem::exists, sleep_for, and then opening the file in load_config.
Run 2 identified the division by zero, but overclaimed severity as Medium instead of Low.
